      "status_by_quote": "Yes, both changes are prerequisites for updating Qt to 6.12. However, I thought it would be better to consider them sepa"

      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Why is OSX_SDK_VERSION set to 15.0 instead of 26.1, which is the SDK version included in the sysroot?",
